pages.text: Claim your land so nobody else can break blocks or open chests there.$(br2)Open the world map ($(l)M$()), then right-click chunks to claim them. Or press the $(l)'$() (apostrophe) key for the claims menu.
In the claims menu, make a $(l)party$() and invite friends.$(br2)Party members can build in each other's claims and see each other on the map.
pages.title: Parties
